title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the silent stacks of Baker-Berry to the historic tea service at Sanborn, these ten campus environments offer distinct atmospheres for focused academic work.

cards.title: Baker Library Tower Room
cards.subtitle: Baker-Berry Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Work in a quintessential academic setting with large windows and comfortable armchairs. This silent space is ideal for long reading sessions and focused individual study.
cards.short_summary: A historic, silent reading room in Baker Library known for its traditional atmosphere and campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tower Room is located on the second floor of Baker Library and is described as a quiet space with couches, chairs, and views of the outdoors.
cards.source_title: A Guide to Study Spots | Dartmouth Admissions
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight during the week and 2:00 AM on weekends for students.

cards.title: Sanborn Library
cards.subtitle: Sanborn House
cards.notes: Study in a wood-paneled room that hosts a daily tea tradition at 4:00 PM. It offers a quiet, scholarly environment with leather armchairs and heavy wooden tables.
cards.short_summary: A historic English Department library famous for its daily afternoon tea service and dark academia aesthetic.
cards.evidence_claim: Sanborn Library offers a tea service each weekday afternoon at 4:00 PM and features butternut paneling and leather armchairs.
cards.source_title: A Teatime Tradition Begins in Sanborn Library - Dartmouth
cards.access_notes: Tea is served weekdays 4:00 PM–5:00 PM; the space is a quiet study area outside of tea hours.

cards.title: 1902 Room
cards.subtitle: Baker Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Utilize this 24-hour study space for late-night sessions. It features soft seating and a normal noise level, making it suitable for both group and individual work.
cards.short_summary: A popular 24/7 study room in Baker Library offering a mix of soft seating and table space.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1902 Room is open 24 hours a day and is one of the most popular rooms in the library for individual or group study.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 with a valid Dartmouth ID.

cards.entity_name: Rauner Special Collections Library Reading Room
cards.title: Rauner Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Webster Hall
cards.notes: Work in the brightly-lit Rooke Reading Room surrounded by rare manuscripts. Follow strict reading room protocols, such as using pencils only and storing bags in lockers.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, high-ceilinged reading room in Webster Hall used for studying and accessing special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Rauner Library's reading room is a brightly-lit, quiet space where visitors are welcome to study following specific expectations.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Rauner Special Collections Library
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during business hours; personal belongings must be stored in provided lockers.

cards.title: Sherman Art Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Carpenter Hall
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot among the art reference collections. The room features soaring windows and crafted wooden paneling, providing a serene environment for visual research.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library space for art and architecture students featuring natural light and quiet study carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: Sherman Art Library has two study rooms with the Art Reference Collection and quiet study spaces on lower levels.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Sherman Art Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Carpenter Hall; accessible from North Main Street or through Baker-Berry Library.

cards.title: Irving Institute Atrium
cards.subtitle: Irving Institute for Energy & Society
cards.notes: Collaborate in this modern, energy-efficient building. The atrium offers comfortable seating and a cafe, making it a preferred spot for group meetings and informal study.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary, high-ceilinged atrium in the West End designed for collaboration and informal interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Irving building offers a range of open work, study, and collaboration spaces, including an atrium open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public weekdays 7:00 AM–8:00 PM; swipe access for the Dartmouth community until 11:00 PM.

cards.entity_name: Black Family Visual Arts Center Arts Forum
cards.title: BVAC Arts Forum
cards.subtitle: Black Family Visual Arts Center
cards.notes: Study on the ground floor red couches within this three-story atrium. The space is surrounded by studios and galleries, offering a creative and modern atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A central three-story atrium in the visual arts building used for study and cross-disciplinary interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arts Forum is a three-story central atrium at the heart of the Visual Arts Center, with ground floor seating used for study.
cards.source_title: My Five Favorite Study Spots at Dartmouth (Updated!)
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during building hours; features large picture windows facing the Arts Plaza.

cards.title: Feldberg Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Murdough Center
cards.notes: Access large tables and individual carrels in the West End's primary library. It is a quiet hub for business and engineering students with access to Bloomberg Terminals.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative library space serving the Tuck and Thayer schools with dedicated research tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Feldberg Library has large tables, individual study spaces, and reservable study rooms within the Murdough Center.
cards.access_notes: General public hours are typically 8:00 AM–8:00 PM; subject librarians available weekdays.

cards.title: Kresge Library
cards.subtitle: Fairchild Hall, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Enjoy quiet study with views of the campus from the third floor. This library supports the physical sciences and offers rolling whiteboards and public computers.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library in the Fairchild Physical Sciences Center known for its views and specialized collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Kresge Library is located on the 3rd floor of Fairchild Hall and offers quiet study spaces and great views.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic terms; check library website for current seasonal hours.

cards.title: Collis Common Ground
cards.subtitle: Collis Student Center
cards.notes: Study in the heart of campus life. This versatile lounge space is often used for informal gatherings and individual work between classes.
cards.short_summary: The iconic central lounge and event space within the Collis Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Ground is an iconic student lounge and event space in the Collis Student Center, open for informal use.
cards.source_title: About the Collis Student Center - Dartmouth
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 1:00 AM; accessible to all students.
